chunks: My father (peace be upon him) narrated from Saad ibn Abdullah from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Fadhal from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) who said:

I heard him saying: Those who love each other for the sake of Allah, on the Day of Judgment, will be on pulpits of light. The light of their faces and bodies and the light of their pulpits will illuminate everything, until they are recognized as those who loved each other for the sake of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.الْمُتَحَابُّونَ فِي اللَّهِ: Those who love each other for the sake of Allah

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for loving each other for the sake of Allah on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Thawab al-Amal, Shaykh al-Saduq narrates from Imam al-Sadiq (Abu al-Hasan) that those who love one another solely for Allah’s sake will be seated on pulpits of light on the Day of Resurrection, their radiance serving as a divine identifier. This hadith highlights the spiritual elevation of *al-mutahabbun fi Allah*, emphasizing that their mutual affection is a tangible manifestation of divine love, distinct from worldly ties. The imagery of light (*nur*) underscores their purity and closeness to God, a concept deeply rooted in Shia eschatology.
